about: The 30 s ad cut (boss request, 2026-10-05): shot ids from the 76 s reference (shots.json), each trimmed from its start to the frame count here. Cuts before the drop sit on ROAR's beats (beat 64 kick on frame 69, one beat = 12.766 frames); the drop (beat 324) lands on frame 534 = shot 30's frame 36, where the GT3 RS's engine fires. tools/cut30.py builds shots30.json and sfx/events30.json from this; src/Ad.tsx builds the Ad30 composition from it.
